title: Chapter 95 Show Yourself, Baby
content:
Chapter 95 Show Yourself, Baby

After trying it, he found that the mud in the mud pit had been buried by the corpses of these beasts.

He quickly created a mud pit inside the city wall.

"Show yourself, little baby!"

A two-meter-tall mud puppet slowly crawled out of the mud.

There was mud and water dripping all over its body.

Control it to jump into the ant group and activate the taunt skill.

The surrounding ants were indeed attracted.

However, a mud puppet can't affect the overall situation at all, and it can be ignored for millions of ants.

Wang Shuo shook his head, with a hint of bitterness at the corner of his mouth.

After a little thought, Wang Shuo made a new decision.

"Prepare the thunder."

Wang Shuo ordered the combatants: "Throw it at the place where the monsters are most dense."

"Bang..."

"Bang, bang..."

The sound of explosions was endless, like the beating of war drums, full of rhythm.

In an instant, the ant army was directly cleared out in several pieces.

The damage at the center of the explosion was as high as 500 points, and even at the edge, the damage was 200 points.

On the ranking list, the number of enemies killed by Wana Village rose rapidly.

It soon jumped to the top 50.

Wang Shuo was a little surprised that with such fierce firepower, the number of enemies killed was only ranked 50.

After a careful look, he found that he knew two people in the top ten.

The fifth place was Jiuyang Village, the village chief Zhang Yang, and the seventh place was Tianba Village, the village chief Ye Tianba.

Wang Shuo had an impression of these two people. They were the people who won the top ten with him in the novice trial.

It seems that they are well prepared!

How does the saying go.

——Don't underestimate the heroes of the world.

After paying attention to the ranking for a while, Wang Shuo came back to his senses and continued to command the battle.

After consuming 500 thunder bombs, the marching ants were basically eliminated.

At this time, another system prompt sounded:

[Bai Lian Village was attacked by wild beasts in the village-level administrative center and was removed from the system. 】

【Osaka Village was attacked by wild beasts and the village administrative center was removed from the system. 】

…

Some long strings of system prompts made Wang Shuo even more nervous.

If tung oil and thunder bombs were not prepared, Wana Village would probably not escape the fate of being removed from the list!

This survival trial is indeed extremely difficult!

After the ant army, new monsters surged up.

It really never stopped.

Violent apes, fire scorpions, demon snakes, human-faced spiders...

At this time, new birds in the sky joined the attacking team again.

All kinds of wild beasts, like a tide, came overwhelmingly.

The tense fighting atmosphere permeated Wana Village!

Everyone was a little breathless for a while.

Among these attacking beasts, there were also many elite beasts, especially the violent ape clan.

Each violent ape was more than 3 meters long. They used fists the size of a baby's head to slap their chests hard, making a thunderous roar.

"Roar!"

The level of the violent ape is 18, and its attack power is as high as more than 200.

They can directly threaten the safety of the city wall.

"Arrow tower activated."

"Energy tower, aim at the elite monster!"

Since these defense towers need people to control them, the damage can be maximized.

Wang Shuo directly selected 20 people from the logistics staff to control the energy tower.

As for the arrow tower, just attack it at will!

There is really no more manpower.

Nearly 100 people in Wang Shuo's territory, everyone is busy.

Especially the logistics team, who have to clean up the corpses, transport tung oil, and control the arrow tower.

Everyone is busy, like a gyroscope, spinning non-stop!

The damage of the energy tower can reach 800 points, which is very effective against elite monsters.

The high-frequency attack of the arrow tower is the nemesis of beasts with low health.

After the bombardment of the thunder, the injured beasts generally have low health, and the arrow tower is more powerful, killing countless enemies.

The beasts fell in groups.
